rels.sql: SELECT o_orderkey, CASE WHEN o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' OR o_orderpriority = '2-HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS high_line_count, CASE WHEN o_orderpriority <> '1-URGENT' AND o_orderpriority <> '2-HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS low_line_count FROM orders ORDER BY o_orderkey

SELECT l_orderkey, l_shipmode, NOT ((l_shipmode = 'TRUCK' OR l_shipmode = 'REG AIR') AND l_commitdate < l_receiptdate AND (l_shipdate < l_commitdate AND (l_receiptdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND l_receiptdate < DATE '1995-01-01'))) AS dummy_tag FROM (SELECT l_orderkey, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipmode FROM lineitem) AS t ORDER BY l_orderkey, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate
